Field_ExamineCell (field/field_sequence/triggers.c) takes a search result as an event routine when bits 27-24 are set, as in every GBA code address; a wasm function pointer is a table index (0x10000-0x1ffff, trap 26) with none of them, so every examine event (the minotaur reliefs, the Sol Entrance door...) ran as a locked chest ("but Isaac can't open it..."). Every FIND_ value is >= 0x100000, so the index range is unambiguous (trap 40)
